content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element.
content.rationale: The save-failure remedy is where the ordering, the failed-write refusal, the refusal site and the reversion remedy meet; the gate forces the decision to answer to all four without re-deciding any — the graph returns to its pre-invocation state, the marker file is left as it was, and the cause is named. All four edges are one prose cell (natural→natural), so the criterion is that cell's gate form.
